statement: Pinned public host implementations provide distinct direct hidraw/feature-report and kernel-derived evdev consumer paths for Switch Pro. A virtual Switch Pro UHID node's host driver/SDL backend must be observed rather than assumed from VID/PID or mapping database.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in part 1 and G, host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer-routing documentation only: SDL HIDAPI Switch reads feature/subcommand 0x80 USB handshake, 0x21 subcommand ACKs and 0x30 full IMU input; hid-nintendo owns handshake and creates evdev; joycond depends on hid-nintendo evdev and can create a separate virtual pad. No actual Steam, SDL, browser, Wine, InputPlumber or emulator host test was run. Additional independent source pin: Chromium Gamepad Linux udev input/hidraw enumeration; WebHID has both static and dynamic protection rules. InputPlumber source matching is version-scoped and does not assert a local host pass.
